caption: The drawing depicts an object composed of several main parts, rendered in shades of dark brown, gray, black, and metallic colors on a plain light-beige background. At the base, there is a round, fluted-edged tray that appears metallic and grayish, holding the entire object. Rising from the center of the tray is a cylindrical, vertical stem supported by three equally spaced braces that are connected to the tray’s edge. Attached above the stem is a large, symmetric, two-part vessel with an almost diamond-like, bulbous shape, colored with dark brown and muted olive-green highlights indicating reflective surfaces. The vessel has a circular handle ring on one side. On top of this vessel is a vertical cylindrical tube, resembling a narrow chimney or spout, and next to its base is a small spout with a conical cover, under which some darker material is visible. The entire composition is centered, and the colors are predominantly muted earth tones with detailed shading to suggest three-dimensionality and metallic reflections.
title: Lard or Whale Oil Lamp
